title: NesTok: Nested Self-Aligned 1D Tokenizer for Autoregressive Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.36756v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: One-dimensional (1D) variable-length visual tokenizers enable adaptive compression by varying the number of tokens, allowing downstream autoregressive (AR) models to flexibly trade off generation quality against computational cost using a single tokenizer. However, existing approaches based on nested dropout often fail to fully exploit the representational capacity of the tokenizer, resulting in suboptimal performance in both image reconstruction and generation. In this work, we introduce NesTok, a nested self-alignment framework tailored to dynamic visual tokenizers. NesTok introduces cross-length training, which jointly optimizes reconstruction across token lengths while using the full-length sequence to guide shorter counterparts, enabling shorter token sequences to approach the reconstruction quality of full-length sequences. On ImageNet, NesTok improves substantially over standard training and achieves an rFID score of 0.98. On do

translated_title: NesTok：面向自回归图像生成的嵌套自对齐一维分词器
translated_abstract: 一维（1D）可变长度视觉分词器通过改变token数量实现自适应压缩，使下游自回归（AR）模型能够仅使用单一分词器在生成质量与计算成本之间进行灵活权衡。然而，现有的基于嵌套dropout的方法往往未能充分利用分词器的表示能力，导致图像重建和生成性能欠佳。在本工作中，我们提出了NesTok，一个专为动态视觉分词器设计的嵌套自对齐框架。NesTok引入了跨长度训练，在联合优化不同token长度下重建效果的同时，利用全长序列来引导较短的序列，使较短的token序列能够接近全长序列的重建质量。在ImageNet上，NesTok相比标准训练取得了显著提升，达到了0.98的rFID分数。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出NesTok嵌套自对齐框架，通过跨长度训练以全长序列引导短序列，显著提升一维可变长度视觉分词器的表示能力，在ImageNet上实现0.98的rFID重建分数并改进自回归图像生成。
en_tdlr: NesTok introduces a nested self-alignment framework with cross-length training, where full-length sequences guide shorter ones, substantially improving 1D variable-length visual tokenizers and achieving an rFID of 0.98 on ImageNet for better autoregressive image generation.
